name: worms-marine-taxa-mcp-server
description: Resolve WoRMS marine species names; fetch classifications, synonyms, distributions, traits, and IDs via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Resolve WoRMS marine species names; fetch classifications, synonyms, distributions, traits, and IDs via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Resolve scientific and common names against the World Register of Marine Species, follow accepted taxa, and retrieve classifications, synonyms, distributions, and trait evidence. Eight read-only tools preserve source citations, unknown scientific facts, and trait hierarchy, and crosswalk AphiaIDs with nine external identifier systems. No API key is required; connect over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
